brace-expansion is a transitive dependency; the only fixed release (5.0.8) is in the 5.x major line, with no backport to the 1.x line, which ends at 1.1.17. Waiting for upstream to provide a fix for the 1.x line.

The only fixed release is in the 5.x major line. brace-expansion is a transitive dependency here and is already at 2.1.2, the latest release in the 2.x line. Adopting the 5.x fix would require a major-version bump, which carries a real risk of breaking the dependents that request the 2.x line; we are not taking that risk. We are waiting for upstream dependents to move off the 2.x major line so a compatible fixed version becomes reachable.
